_doc: Mixture for s09_mix.py, per level. textbook_levels: which levels' textbooks go into the run (keep it cumulative: medium = [easy, medium], hard = [easy, medium, hard]). textbook_epochs: copies of the textbooks in the training stream. replay_tokens: exact Qwen3.5 tokens to take from each replay source (must be <= what s07 collected). val_*: held-out shares.
